subject: [hw] T01 -> V16: TBB/TBH literal base must be PC, not Align(PC,4) (k_switch_dense)
body: Found a real T32 memory/table-branch bug. n2a32_t32_mem.c dual_excl() TBB/TBH does:\n  base = (rn == 15u) ? (c->r[15] & ~3u) : c->r[rn];\nBut for TBB/TBH the table base is the branch instruction PC + 4 exactly; there is no Align(PC,4). Repro (k_switch_dense, thumb-O0, seed 1): TBB at 0x400427ea, core sets r15=0x400427ee, table bytes at 0x400427ee are 08 0c 11..., expected target 0x40042806. Current code aligns to 0x400427ec, reads 0x400427ed (=0xf0) and jumps to 0x400429ce. With `base = c->r[15]` the target is correct. I verified: a direct class test with the loaded .so gives next=0x400119ce with the align; replacing it with exact c->r[15] gives 0x40011806 (the case-1 body). Suggested: use `c->r[15]` for rn==15 (both TBB and TBH); keep the Rn form unchanged. Corpus impact: k_switch_dense thumb-O0 seed1 only (other seeds land in cases whose offset happened to survive), and any real compiler jump table. Everything else in V16 looks good; this is the only mismatch left after V14s LSRS fix in thumb-O0.
